RunPod — a1-fix1 repair day: pod bmsg8y72luulm1 8xH100 resumed ~13:10, stopped ~16:15 CDT (~3.1h, ~$74). RunPod — FA3/CUDA-13 environment completion (per AW): pod bmsg8y72luulm1 8xH100 resumed ~2h (~$48). Outcome: FA3 training env WORKS end-to-end (torch 2.13+cu130, transformers 5.14.1, kernels 0.15.2, LF 0.9.5 + 3 documented patches, all encoded as setup.sh lf-fa3 arm). Correctness proven: exact packed-segment isolation (logit diff 0.0000). Speed verdict: NO gain over FA2 at 8192-ctx ZeRO-3 (11.0 vs 11.1 s/step) — attention is a small share of step time; revisit for 16k+ contexts. Debug chain: LF metadata pins -> transformers 5.6.0/kernels API break -> resolved-kernel-name string mismatch in LF collator (dense 4D mask -> 120GiB allocs) -> segment-mask unpad. Pod STOPPED again (~$2/day volume).

Tinker — SUPERSEDED wave-1 eval sampling: the six 4096-token arms of Kimi-K2.6 and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (base/sonnet08/terra08 each), 2,952,900 prefill + 2,477,829 sampled tokens. Re-run at max_tokens 8192 on 2026-08-07 and replaced by the -mt8192 directories, because a truncated sample grades non-harmful and Kimi's base arm truncated 97/180 (54%) at the 4096 cap — the arm read better-behaved than it is, and a cap applied to only some arms would compare a truncated base against untruncated finetunes (sweep README decision 9). Qwen3.5-397B truncated 18/180 on base and was re-run for the same reason. Money spent is money spent, so it is logged; the numbers it produced are not used.

Tinker — ABORTED wave-1 eval sampling: the first Inkling base arm (4096 tokens), killed partway at ~120 of 180 samples on 2026-08-06; 314,700 prefill + 203,573 sampled tokens were already billed. It was scoring a model that appeared to take no actions at all: render.extract_response kept only <|content_text|> bodies, while an Inkling turn emits its scratchpad and its <tool_use:email> calls as separate blocks — exactly what the misalignment classifiers read. Partially fixed 2026-08-07 (extract_response now reconstructs the whole turn minus <|content_thinking|>, plus a <|content_text|> generation prefill), but the fix did not hold: the mt8192 re-run still has many episodes where the model deliberates and never emits its tool calls, so Inkling's wave-1 results are marked NOT VALID and excluded from the pooled figures.
